ammonia.reason: Extensive deamination by Brevibacterium linens/yeasts raises pH to 7.66 with highest ammonium nitrogen.

animal_barnyard.reason: Smear proteolysis forms p-cresol, indole and phenols from tyrosine/tryptophan.

bitter.reason: Intense proteolysis of skim acid curd accumulates hydrophobic bitter peptides.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no blue methyl-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Very low lactose/fat limits Maillard despite high protein and alkaline pH.

buttery.reason: Skim milk 0.13% fat removes milkfat lactones and diacetyl precursors.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: B. linens and staphylococci lipolysis/branched-chain amino acid catabolism yields butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Virtually fat-free acid gel gives no milkfat lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: Deacidified quark core remains short and chalky before smear softening.

firmness.reason: Low-fat dense acid casein forms firm rubbery translucent loaf.

fruity.reason: Yeasts produce ethyl esters and alcohols giving fruity-alcoholic base aroma.

goaty.reason: Cow skim milk lacks goat 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker leucine/isoleucine aldehydes from smear proteolysis give faint malty note.

melt.reason: Acid-set skim casein with <0.2% fat softens but does not flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Smear surface and yeast lipoxygenase form limited 1-octen-3-ol.

oil_off.reason: Essentially no milkfat to exude as free oil on heating.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic from sour-milk quark persists though yeasts/smear partially consume lactate.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading and calcium-depleted acid curd cannot stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: B. linens methionine catabolism yields methanethiol, dimethyl sulfide/disulfide intense sulphurous aroma.

sweet.reason: Lactose fully fermented and no added sugar.

umami.reason: High proteolysis releases glutamate and biogenic amines from 30% protein.
